A '''hepatizon axe''' is an [[Tools#Axe|axe]] of the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper axe]] with [[hepatizon alloy]]. It fells trees at speed {{Value|Hepatizon Axe|miningspeed}}, the fastest of any axe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the copper item carry over.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It breaks axe blocks at speed {{Value|Hepatizon Axe|miningspeed}} and has {{Value|Hepatizon Axe|durability}} durability. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Hepatizon Axe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Hepatizon Axe|attackspeed}}. While held in the main hand it adds 0.0055 to movement speed, 5.5% of the player's base speed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_axe.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* Hepatizon tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.
* Its attack speed modifier has no slot, so it also applies while the axe is held in the off hand.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_axe.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Bronze" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Hepatizon equipment was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal item in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Mining speed raised from about 13 to 20, to keep hepatizon worth using after adamant.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
